name: Ashway Supply
objective: Carry iron through the ash fields before the forge fires die.
intro_text: The old forest ends in a country of grey grass and red sky. The forges need iron tonight, and the ash keeps finding every seam in the wagon.
outro_text: The forge fires catch. Every hammer in Ashway rings for the road crew.
reward_note: Ashway pays a hazard premium for every intact ingot.

name: Charcoal Ridge
objective: Beat the night stretch before the charcoal loses its heat.
bonus_objective: Arrive with at least 12 seconds remaining.
intro_text: The kiln road has no shade and no landmarks, only the red glow of distant pits. We travel by the warmth in the cargo and the stars above it.
outro_text: The kiln masters get their heat before dawn. The ridge can keep its ghosts.
reward_note: The charcoal contract rewards speed without a broken wheel.

name: Fogbound Procession
objective: Lead the procession through cursed fog without losing the road.
intro_text: Fog crawls out of the fen in daylight now. The families keep close to the lanterns, and the lanterns keep going dark.
outro_text: The last family reaches the dry road. Behind them, the fog closes like a door.
reward_note: The guild adds a protection bonus for every family that arrives together.

name: Witchfire Run
objective: Keep the cinder salts stable while witchfire rolls across the causeway.
intro_text: The apothecary calls them salts. The blue flames call them food. Either way, they must reach the war hospitals before the causeway burns through.
outro_text: The hospitals have enough salts for a week. The blue fire has nowhere left to feed.
reward_note: The apothecary pays more for salts that arrive bright and potent.

name: Cinder Watch
objective: Reinforce the watchtower before its signal goes out.
intro_text: The watchtowers are the only lights left between the march and the capital. One has gone dark. We carry the gold to light it again.
outro_text: The tower burns gold against the ash. The capital sees the signal and answers.
reward_note: The watch pays a signal premium for every coin that reaches the tower.

name: Ashen Gate
objective: Break the ash army's last roadblock and reach the gate.
bonus_objective: Arrive with at least 10 seconds to spare.
intro_text: The gate is still standing because the road crews are. This is the last push before the frontier becomes a graveyard.
outro_text: The Ashen Gate opens. The road into the frontier is ours again.
reward_note: The frontier charter doubles the gate's final-mile reward.

name: Frostline Charter
objective: Carry the frontier charter over the frozen line.
intro_text: Past the gate, the grass turns white and the road turns brittle. The charter must reach the northern holds before the first full freeze.
outro_text: The northern holds sign the charter. A new road opens under the snow.
reward_note: The northern holds pay in advance for a charter that survives the frost.

name: Moonwell Medicine
objective: Deliver tonic through the night stretch before the moonwell freezes.
intro_text: The moonwell is the only cure for the white fever. Its water freezes at midnight, and the trail has no intention of helping us.
outro_text: The tonic is poured before the well ices over. The fever breaks by morning.
reward_note: A living village is worth more than any cargo bonus.

name: Blackglass Bridge
objective: Hold the envoy's wagon together while the bridge fights back.
intro_text: The cult envoy knows why the roads are cursed. Unfortunately, so do the things that want him silenced.
outro_text: The envoy reaches the magistrate alive. The first truth about the road is finally spoken.
reward_note: The envoy's knowledge earns a danger premium for the escort crew.

name: Starfall Relay
objective: Get the beacon core to the relay before the sky closes.
bonus_objective: Arrive with at least 14 seconds remaining.
intro_text: The beacons are failing one by one. The core in my hold is the last spare between the frontier and a night with no roads at all.
outro_text: The relay wakes. Blue fire stitches a path across the frontier sky.
reward_note: The relay guild pays for every minute of light returned to the road.

name: Winter Court
objective: Bring the treaty feast through the haunted snow intact.
intro_text: The northern court will sign if the feast arrives. It will not sign if the frost spirits arrive first.
outro_text: The treaty is signed over a warm meal. The road has its first peace in a generation.
reward_note: The court's reward is generous because a broken treaty costs more.

name: King's End
objective: Carry the standard to the road's end and break the curse at its source.
intro_text: Every road in the kingdom points here now. At the end waits the thing that taught the fog, fire, and dead to hunt wagons.
outro_text: The standard rises at King's End. The curse breaks, and the roads remember daylight.
reward_note: The final contract pays the whole kingdom's debt to its road crews.

name: Old Roads Reckoning
objective: Reopen the first mile for the crews who kept the kingdom moving.
intro_text: The curse is gone, but a road is not repaired by victory alone. We take tools back to the first mile and start again.
outro_text: The first mile is open. The kingdom begins its long work.
reward_note: Side work for the road crews pays in gratitude and gold.

name: Lanterns in the Fog
objective: Escort the wardens back into the fen to extinguish the last cursed lights.
intro_text: Some lanterns still burn where no one lit them. The wardens volunteer to put them out, and ask for a driver who has seen the fog before.
outro_text: The last false lantern goes dark. The fen is only a fen again.
reward_note: The wardens pay for every false light put out safely.

name: Emberline Rescue
objective: Reach a stranded road crew before the ember hounds find them.
intro_text: The old route crews are trapped beyond a firebreak. Their medicine is ours now, and the ember hounds are already on the scent.
outro_text: The crew walks out together. The hounds retreat into a fire that no longer feeds them.
reward_note: The rescued crews return the favor in future road repairs.

name: The Wraiths' Last Winter
objective: Carry the witnesses to the moonwell and end their haunting.
intro_text: The wraiths are not all enemies. Some are witnesses who have been trapped in the white mile since before the curse began.
outro_text: The witnesses cross the moonwell's light. Winter finally lets them go.
reward_note: The witnesses carry a piece of the old road's history.

name: The Unfinished Road
objective: Move rebuilding coin through every biome to fund the new road.
intro_text: A kingdom can be saved and still be poor. The rebuilding coin goes through every old danger so the new road can go around them.
outro_text: The first new stones are set. The road is unfinished, which means it is alive.
reward_note: Every repaired mile increases the value of the next contract.

name: Roadkeepers' Oath
objective: Defend the roadkeepers while they lay the foundation stone.
intro_text: The founder's wheel is a symbol, until someone has to carry it through the places where the road died. We make the oath real one mile at a time.
outro_text: The roadkeepers take their oath. Somewhere ahead, another road is waiting.
reward_note: The roadkeepers' final contract funds the next chapter.
